phrases.english: What tone should I use, friendly but firm?

phrases.english: Can you repeat that, a little slower?

phrases.english: Should I explain, or just keep it simple?

phrases.english: What if my German sounds messy, okay?

phrases.english: How do you respond, when you get interrupted?

phrases.english: Can we switch roles, so I practice courage?

phrases.english: What’s one question that builds confidence?

phrases.english: You’ve got this, breathe, then go.

phrases.english: Small step today, big confidence tomorrow.
phrases.german: Kleiner Schritt heute, große Sicherheit morgen.

phrases.english: Own your moment, even if it’s imperfect.

phrases.english: Say it anyway, courage loves practice.
phrases.german: Sag’s einfach trotzdem, Mut braucht Übung.

phrases.english: I like your brave energy, keep it.
phrases.german: Ich mag deine mutige Energie, bleib dabei.

phrases.english: It’s okay to stumble, you’re still learning.

phrases.english: You don’t need perfect, just honest effort.
phrases.german: Du brauchst nicht perfekt, nur ehrliche Mühe.

phrases.english: Every try counts, even the weird ones.

phrases.english: Trust your gut, it’s guiding you forward.
phrases.german: Vertrau deinem Bauchgefühl, es bringt dich weiter.

phrases.english: Confidence is built, one brave sentence at a time.

phrases.english: Keep going, the fear shrinks each time.

phrases.english: Be brave, ask again, you’ll get it.

phrases.english: Hold steady, you’re stronger than doubt.

phrases.english: Give yourself credit, you’re learning fast.

phrases.english: Keep the momentum, courage comes next.

phrases.english: When you falter, reset, then try again.

phrases.english: I admit I’m nervous, but I’ll speak anyway.

phrases.english: My fear talks first, then my words catch up.

phrases.english: I tell myself, slow down, you’re still learning.

phrases.english: I respect my pace, even when others fly.
